194:t_1:3.en: ～$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$　Hangar～

194:t_1:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Make sure you save $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$-chan. I helped make their costumes, after all.」

194:t_1:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then it's $$ラース・バビロン$$... Make sure you win.」

194:t_1:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Look... This is a farewell scene. Can't you say something a little more... you know...?」

194:t_1:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「What do you mean by 'a little more'...?」

194:t_1:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Like 'I'll definitely win,' or 'I'll make a miracle happen'...」

194:t_1:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「Victory is merely the result of strategy and tactics. A soldier simply does his utmost within them.」

194:t_1:14.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yes, yes... I'm glad you're the same as ever, even before a major operation.」

194:t_1:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...But... make sure you come back...」

194:t_1:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll try. With everything I have.」

194:t_1:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain... Why are you in the hangar...?」

194:t_1:22.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm saying goodbye to everyone. The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ will be operating separately from here.」

194:t_1:23.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'll make sure $$カナメ$$ gets back to Japan too.」

194:t_1:25.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So $$カナメ$$ matters more to you than saying goodbye to me.」

194:t_1:27.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm kidding. I'm just teasing you a little as a friend.」

194:t_1:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then let me say something too. As a friend.」

194:t_1:32.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Whatever... happens after this, he and I will probably remain 'friends'...)

194:t_1:33.en:
$$テッサ$$
(In the end, I couldn't win... Against that girl... Against the dazzling world she belongs to...)

194:t_1:34.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Maybe I... only admired that world through him...)

194:t_1:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Yes... Of course... Whenever something became clear, $$相良$$ always headed straight toward it...)

194:t_1:45.en:
$$テッサ$$
(So... this is for the best...)

194:t_1:48.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm just a little... a little disappointed, I guess...」

194:t_1:50.en:
$$テッサ$$
(He isn't making excuses or trying to comfort me... No, he's desperately holding those words back...)

194:t_1:51.en:
$$テッサ$$
(I loved that honesty of yours, $$相良$$...)

194:t_1:53.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I have no regrets left now. Sergeant $$相良$$, let's each do our utmost in our coming missions.」

194:t_1:55.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And... one word of advice. Once you've rescued $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$, please look after $$ランカ$$.」

194:t_1:57.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...No... That was presumptuous of me. Please forget it.」

194:t_1:59.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Well then, $$相良$$... I wish you the best.」

194:t_1:61.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Goodbye, $$相良$$... And goodbye to my feelings...)

194:t_1:63.en:
$n
「There you are, $$宗介$$. The infiltration briefing is about to begin.」

194:t_1:66.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... It's nothing. I'll be right there.」

194:t_1:68.en:
$$宗介$$
「...$n... Let's make sure we both return to $$陣代高校$$.」

194:t_1:70.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$... We've only just parted, but right now... I want to see you so badly...)

194:t_1:74.en: ～$$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$　Detention Facility～

194:t_1:76.en:
$$シェリル$$
「How cheap of them. Locking the $$銀河の妖精$$ and the Super-Dimensional Cinderella in a dim place like this.」

194:t_1:78.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Hey... Why don't we sing a little to lift our spirits? A little jailhouse rock has its charms.」

194:t_1:79.en:
$$シェリル$$
「And if it can help the people imprisoned here, even a little...」

194:t_1:80.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm sorry... I just... can't get in that mood...」

194:t_1:82.en:
$$シェリル$$
「But it'll be all right. $$アルト$$ and the others... $c will come for us, I know it.」

194:t_1:83.en:
$$ランカ$$
「You have faith in $$アルト$$, don't you, $$シェリル$$...?」

194:t_1:84.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Am I being a little optimistic? But he's always...」
